document_title: The Million Dollar Homepage - Own a piece of internet history!
evidence_method: Direct parse of the HTML response returned by the live page during this field study.

page_source_comment.description: Only broken links have been replaced with Wayback Machine snapshots.
page_source_comment.verification_status: The page comment claims 1,164 replacements. The live homepage parse directly verified 80 rewritten image-map areas; it did not independently establish 1,164 rewritten links on the homepage.

established: The inspected response contains 251 image-map area elements.
Every inspected area element lacks an alt attribute.
Every inspected area element has an href and title attribute.
80 inspected area elements have class wayback-replaced and preserve data-original-url.
unknown: Whether the title values are announced consistently as accessible names by current assistive technologies.
Whether the current desktop and mobile image-map interaction is operable with keyboard and screen readers.
Whether all outbound snapshot targets load correctly.
Whether the page-source comment's 1,164-link count refers to this page, a wider crawl, or a generated site bundle.

scope_note: Structural evidence only; this is not a WCAG conformance audit or an evaluation of all external destinations.
